t: Reported Statement Of A.S. Denisoff China Daily Herald

pages.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. 1. 36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Branch    Stations/
REPORT    Date September 23, 1937    807"
Subject Reported statement of A.S. Denisoff (China Daily Herald) regarding
the alleged pro-Japanese attitude of the "Shanghai Zaria".
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by S. Clauson S.I.

With reference to the attached translation from
the "Shanghai Zaria" of September 23, 1937, enquiries show that
the individual who is reported to have made allegations to a
group of Chinese journalists regarding the pro-Japanese atti-
tude of the "Shanghai Zaria", is Mr. A.S. DENISOFF, actual edi-
tor of the local Soviet newspaper "China Daily Herald".

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Crime & Special Branches )

（批：DB / 23.9.）
（批：JL / DSR. / 30/9.）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / 24 SEP 1937 / (C. & S. BRANCH)）

事由：关于《上海柴拉报》（Shanghai Zaria）据称持亲日态度的报道，A.S. 杰尼索夫（A.S. Denisoff，《中国每日先驱报》）的陈述。
由侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）制作    由督察克劳森（S. Clauson S.I.）转呈

参照所附1937年9月23日《上海柴拉报》的译文，经查询，据报向一群中国记者指控《上海柴拉报》持亲日态度之人，系当地苏维埃报纸《中国每日先驱报》的实际编辑 A.S. 杰尼索夫（A.S. DENISOFF）先生。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
